title: HYBRIT: SSAB, LKAB and Vattenfall first in the world with hydrogen-reduced sponge iron
lineage: Partners’ contemporaneous pilot announcement. Its priority and emissions claims exceed the scope of the record.

passages.quote: Around 100 tonnes have been made so far.
passages.note: By the announcement the pilot in Luleå had produced hydrogen-reduced sponge iron.

passages.locator: Fossil-free electricity and hydrogen storage, first paragraph
passages.quote: by electrolysis of water with fossil-free electricity

passages.note: Dates the test plant opening, not the first hydrogen-reduced product.
